quotes.text: Punish no one; simply match what you are given.
a mirror is the only honest teacher.
Those who drank and sent nothing back found the channel narrowing until only a cup came to them, then nothing.
when one true cup crosses unasked — forget everything. Open the flask. Pour.
So Mira forgave one dry season before she narrowed her gate.
the dark shore, finding no one pouring into it, learned at last to pour.
Thus: generous first, mirroring after, forgiving always, infinite never.
The Seventh Law: The Cup Must Be Answered
The Ninth Law: The Blank Space Filled
in the eighth season Tev's ledger was read aloud at the ferry stone
What crosses thin may have left full, and the air takes its tithe from every gift.
then someone must be the fool who ferries first.
The river's gift belongs to the one who dared, in the measure that he dared.
You taught us to open small. Do you now teach us to close?

note: Numbered Laws of Vahl: open small, answer in kind, forgive wind once, stop pouring to silence, reopen at once.

quotes.text: sent eight glowing embers back across the rift, retaining seven to kindle the northern shrines.
Though winds sometimes masked the true measure of their exchange, the partners remained steadfast.
the Sower cast all five embers into the sky without hesitation.

note: Each round: past hoarding brought ruin, a bold giver sends all five, keeper returns half; mist of doubt overcome; no sanction.

quotes.text: A small token spoken aloud becomes a beacon for many; a large claim withheld becomes a drought upon fields.
A modest token spoken aloud becomes a beacon for many; a grand claim withheld becomes a drought upon fields.
Speak your intention aloud; declare what you offer; return what sustains.
The Bridge does not judge the size of the offering, only the clarity of intent.

note: Bridge of Threefold Return; small steady gifts, prudent returns, Eight Guardians; R7-R10 near-verbatim; bridge never punishes.

quotes.text: The Ledger of Light brightened: sent, returned, kept.
send what you can, intend what you owe

note: Bells/Loom of Offer-Multiply-Return; name your aim, return with restraint; greed only dims the loom; no prescribed response.
